question: Which month and year does the workbook cover?
assumption: Shahrivar 1405 (Jalali) — confirmed by the business; editable in the import configuration. The data only carries the month name, no year.
impact: Period of every fact, target and result.

question: Authoritative branch-group definition (lookup «گروه», lookup «گروه 2», the Power Query rule, or the a/b grouping sheet)?
assumption: None. Two lookup schemes are imported side by side, both UNCONFIRMED; no calculation depends on a branch group yet.
impact: Supervisor/head reward ladders differ per group; Karaj is group 1 in lookups but group 2 in roll-ups (letter-encoding defect).

question: Approved reward thresholds, step amounts and rates per level and brand.
assumption: Manager ladder thresholds 0.97 / 1.12 / 1.22 / 1.32 (from the workbook) and per-row step amounts are used as a PROPOSED rule set. Nothing is approved.
impact: Every calculated reward; results are indicative only and never a payment instruction.

question: Target data source and owner (targets are hard-coded values in the workbook; EFES sellers have targets, Matador sellers none).
assumption: Targets are read from the manager sheet as UNCONFIRMED values with their sheet and row recorded.
impact: Achievement = input ÷ target. Wrong targets change every achievement.

question: Carton basis: fractional base sheet («فروش») or integer-cast derived sheet (SalesData)?
assumption: Base sheet (exact, fractional) is the default calculation basis; the choice is an import-configuration setting. The 55.583-carton gap is shown in reconciliation.

question: Coverage treatment of customers with zero or negative net cartons (workbook counts them: minimum = 0).
assumption: Not implemented in this slice; no coverage metric is calculated.
impact: Seller-level retail reward matrix (EFES +65, Matador +90 retail customers).

question: Policy for duplicate business keys (5 keys appear twice; no invoice id to tell double entry from separate lines).
assumption: keep_flagged: all rows kept with an ordinal and a warning; totals include them.

question: VIP employees with several visitor codes (76 personnel codes shared by 2–3 visitor keys): reward per employee or per visitor code?
assumption: Employee and visitor assignment are separate entities; one employee may own several assignments; no seller-level reward is calculated yet.

question: Manager relief adjustment («ارفاق») and manual corrections to «فروش قطعی».
assumption: Not modelled. Workbook definitive sales and reward are imported as reference figures only; differences are reported, not hidden.
impact: 17 of 49 manager rows differ from the sales extract; reward variance.

question: Manager / head hierarchy and missing identifiers (about half of roster rows have no head personnel code; branch managers are absent from the roster).
assumption: Hierarchy codes are imported as-is; missing head codes are listed as mapping issues; manager level is keyed by branch × line, not by person.

question: Matador league prizes and HQ staff rewards (hard-coded, manual).
assumption: Out of scope for the prototype.
impact: About 1.0 B + 3.7 B Rials in the workbook.

question: Is a monetary sales value (Rials) available or needed? The workbook is carton-only.
assumption: No carton → Rial conversion is performed anywhere.
impact: Demo dashboards are Rial-based; this prototype is carton-based.

question: May real names, customer codes or personnel codes appear on any screen, log or demo?
assumption: No. Only deterministic pseudonyms (V-/E-/C-) are shown; source values stay in the isolated database.

question: Mapping of customer groups to retail / wholesale / HoReCa, and of manager line labels (e.g. «1-2») to sales lines.
assumption: Main-group labels from the CustomerGroup sheet; line labels parsed literally («1-2» = lines 1 and 2). Both UNCONFIRMED.
impact: Which sales feed which manager target.
